details.method: Before a full native suite, preserve the required repository cwd, binary-adjacent tests/data layout, and explicit tested Python executable. Reuse the established runner environment; keep private editor copies for UI fixtures whose own fixture tree is prepared.
details.when: Running Godot native tests on Windows from isolated worktrees or copied editor binaries.
details.counterexample: Changing cwd alone does not fix Crypto fixtures resolved relative to the executable. A PATH python alias can start but fail RuntimeConfig child probes. These setup failures are not implementation regressions or passing validation.
details.trial_plan: On the next same-domain native suite, capture the cwd, executable fixture layout and explicit Python before launch; run the full same-binary suite and verify all applicable assertions while retaining diagnostics.
